posts.name: Katrina Kaif
posts.caption: Katrina delighted fans with her May photo dump featuring unseen moments from Vicky Kaushal's 38th birthday, a 'Happy Birthday Papa' cake, and a rare glimpse of baby Vihaan's tiny hands.

posts.name: Diljit Dosanjh
posts.caption: Diljit's film Main Vaapas Aaunga with Imtiaz Ali releases June 12, while Badshah joined him for a surprise London concert duet. Sardaar Ji 3 drops June 27 internationally.

posts.name: Alia Bhatt
posts.caption: Alia kicks off Alpha promotions ahead of its July 3 release — the first female-led YRF Spy Universe film. She and Sharvari championed women's cricket in a T20 World Cup campaign.

posts.name: Priyanka Chopra
posts.caption: Priyanka confirms six months of shooting remain on SS Rajamouli's ₹1,300 crore epic Varanasi with Mahesh Babu, with a potential Antarctica schedule generating massive buzz.

posts.name: Shah Rukh Khan
posts.caption: SRK's action thriller King with Siddharth Anand, Deepika, and daughter Suhana is locked for Christmas 2026 release. Shooting continues in Mumbai with a massive ensemble cast.

posts.name: Kareena Kapoor Khan
posts.caption: Kareena attended sister Karisma's Brown screening with Saif, calling her 'the absolute 90s Queen.' She's reportedly in talks for a Raj & DK superhero film opposite Salman Khan.

posts.name: Shraddha Kapoor
posts.caption: Shraddha is in talks for Mahavatar opposite Vicky Kaushal and announced animated film Chhoti Stree before Stree 3. Her Naagin trilogy is also back on track for 2026.

posts.name: Deepika Padukone
posts.caption: Deepika will use a body double for action scenes in Allu Arjun's Raka due to her pregnancy, while continuing her role in SRK's King with a South Africa schedule ahead.

posts.name: Ranveer Singh
posts.caption: Ranveer sues FWICE over a non-cooperation directive amid his Don 3 exit controversy. Dhurandhar 2 crossed ₹1,800 crore worldwide and is now streaming on JioHotstar.

posts.name: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan
posts.caption: Aishwarya was named JW Marriott's first-ever Global Brand Ambassador and dazzled at Cannes 2026 with an iconic Banarasi saree and sindoor look that went viral.

posts.name: Rashmika Mandanna
posts.caption: Rashmika stars in Cocktail 2 (June 19) — now IMDb's most-anticipated Indian film of 2026 — and reunites with Vijay Deverakonda for period drama Rana Baali.

posts.name: Samantha Ruth Prabhu
posts.caption: Samantha returns to the big screen with action drama Maa Inti Bangaaram releasing June 19. She revealed Sai Pallavi was the original choice before the film was reworked for her.

posts.name: Allu Arjun
posts.caption: Allu Arjun's mega-budget AA22xA6 with director Atlee features multiple roles and a star-studded cast including Deepika and Rashmika, with a 2027 global release planned.

posts.name: Ram Charan
posts.caption: Ram Charan's Peddi smashed records with ₹150 crore worldwide in just 2 days, beating Dhurandhar and Pathaan's opening day numbers to become a massive box office event.

posts.name: Jr NTR
posts.caption: Jr NTR's Dragon teaser with director Prashanth Neel has generated massive buzz, while he introduced 'two new friends' to fans on his birthday. War 2 is also in the pipeline.

posts.name: Janhvi Kapoor
posts.caption: Janhvi is at the center of the Peddi controversy as director Buchi Babu apologized and promised changes to her scenes. Her makeup artist shared a post defending her professionalism.

posts.name: Ananya Panday
posts.caption: Ananya supported cousin Ahaan Panday's debut film Saiyaara by sharing the trailer. She continues to be in demand after Dream Girl 2's success with multiple projects lined up.

posts.name: Kiara Advani
posts.caption: Kiara wrapped War 2 alongside Hrithik Roshan and Jr NTR, earning a heartfelt note from Hrithik praising her work in the YRF Spy Universe sequel.

posts.name: Hrithik Roshan
posts.caption: Hrithik is making his directorial debut with Krrish 4, reuniting with Priyanka Chopra as the female lead. He also wrapped War 2 with a heartfelt note for co-stars Jr NTR and Kiara.

posts.name: Varun Dhawan
posts.caption: Varun's Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai released June 5 after multiple date reshuffles. He took blessings from co-star Mouni Roy in a sweet on-set moment that went viral.

posts.name: Shreya Ghoshal
posts.caption: Shreya continues her prolific 2026 with songs in Gandhi Talks (with AR Rahman), Bhooth Bangla, and Raja Shivaji — she's recorded her 980th career song and counting.

posts.name: AR Rahman
posts.caption: AR Rahman performed at the Attari Border on June 7 as a tribute to BSF personnel ahead of Main Vaapas Aaunga's release. The Imtiaz Ali film features his latest soundtrack.

posts.name: Vijay Thalapathy
posts.caption: Vijay's political party TVK won 108 seats in Tamil Nadu elections, fueling massive buzz for his farewell film Jana Nayagan. Amazon reportedly stepped back from digital rights amid the leak saga.
